title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 452 (Punishment for wrongful withholding of property)

content.overview: An officer or employee who wrongfully obtains possession of, or wrongfully withholds, any property of the company is punishable, and the court may order delivery of the property.
content.glance: An officer or employee who wrongfully obtains possession of, or wrongfully withholds, any property of the company is punishable, and the court may order delivery of the property.

sections.body: An officer or employee who wrongfully obtains possession of, or wrongfully withholds, any property of the company is punishable, and the court may order delivery of the property.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The order for delivery is in addition to the penalty. The section covers officers and employees. A bona fide dispute of title is a defence.
